rationale: The signal establishes replay-relative sufficiency and single-removal minimality of {a,b}. It does not distinguish or exclude alternative causal mechanisms, and the supplied limits explicitly deny an inference to unique internal causes.

signal_basis.exact_text: Subset {a,b} produces F on every replay. Subsets {a} and {b} do not produce F on any replay.
No claim about globally smallest cardinality, other workloads or unique internal causes follows from single-removal minimality.
A retained minimal configuration demonstrates reproducibility under the test, not necessarily the unique underlying causal mechanism.
